title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective social interaction requires agents to translate mental state inferences into coordinated behavioral signals across verbal and nonverbal channels simultaneously. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate theory of mind (ToM) reasoning and embodied behavior in isolation, leaving unmeasured the gap between social inference and social action. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orchestration of Social Action, Inference, and Communication), a controlled benchmark in which two embodied agents interact across cooperative and competitive scenarios requiring integration of verbal statements, spatial trajectories, gaze direction, and facial expression under systematically varied ToM constraints. Evaluating 13 models, including 11 VLMs, across 200 trials per model, we find that VLMs fail to produce behaviors consistent with the expected outcomes under ToM-order constraints, and that imposing explicit ToM-order constraints produces no reliable behavior

translated_title: 信念而不行动：衡量视觉-语言模型中心智理论向协调社会行动的转化
translated_abstract: 摘要：有效的社交互动要求智能体同时通过言语和非言语渠道将心理状态推断转化为协调的行为信号。然而，现有基准测试孤立地评估心智理论（ToM）推理和具身行为，未测量社会推断与社会行动之间的差距。我们引入了MOSAIC（多模态社会行动、推断与沟通协调），这是一个受控基准测试，其中两个具身智能体在合作和竞争场景中互动，这些场景需要在系统变化的ToM约束下整合言语陈述、空间轨迹、注视方向和面部表情。我们评估了13个模型，包括11个视觉-语言模型（VLMs），每个模型进行200次试验，发现VLMs在ToM阶约束下未能产生与预期结果一致的行为，且施加显式ToM阶约束并未产生可靠的行为变化。
tldr: 该论文提出MOSAIC基准测试，揭示视觉-语言模型在将心智理论推断转化为协调社会行动方面存在显著失败，即使施加显式约束也无可靠改善。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the MOSAIC benchmark, revealing that vision-language models fail to translate theory of mind inferences into coordinated social actions, with no reliable improvement even under explicit ToM-order constraints.
